name: PrinterIQ Finder
author: castleink2

sections.description:
PrinterIQ Finder adds Castle Ink’s free printer finder to your site. A visitor answers seven questions about what they print, how much they print, whether they need color and their budget. The finder then shows three recommended printers with a short reason for each.

Add it to any post or page with the shortcode:

[printeriq_finder]

The finder fills the width of its container and its styles are isolated from your theme. It can appear once per page.

Things to know before you install

  • The finder is free, with no sign-up, account or usage limit.
  • It sets no cookies, shows no ads and collects no names, emails or other personal details.
  • It contains no affiliate links.
  • Each recommendation links to Castle Ink’s printer rankings and to matching ink or toner cartridges on castleink.com. Castle Ink sells compatible and remanufactured cartridges.
  • Links from the finder to castleink.com carry a label so Castle Ink can count visits that come from embedded copies.
  • A “Printer finder by Castle Ink” credit link is available but is off by default. You can turn it on under Settings > Reading.

External services

This plugin is an interface to the PrinterIQ Finder service run by Castle Ink (Phosphor, LLC). The finder itself, including its questions and printer recommendations, is loaded from Castle Ink and is not stored in the plugin.

On any page where you place the [printeriq_finder] shortcode, the visitor’s browser loads this script:

https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0271/2177/8723/files/printeriq-embed.js

The file is hosted on Shopify’s content delivery network. As with any file request, Shopify receives the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent. The plugin sends no other data, and nothing is loaded on pages that do not use the shortcode.

  • About the service: https://castleink.com/pages/embed-printeriq-finder
  • Castle Ink terms of service: https://castleink.com/policies/terms-of-service
  • Castle Ink privacy policy: https://castleink.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Shopify privacy policy: https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Add [printeriq_finder] to a post or page, in a Shortcode block or the classic editor.
  3. Optional: turn on the credit link under Settings > Reading.
sections.faq:
Does it cost anything?

No. The finder is free to use and has no usage limit.

Can I change the questions, colors or recommendations?

No. Castle Ink hosts the finder and controls its wording, colors and printer rankings, and may update them.

Can I show the finder more than once on a page?

No. It appears once per page. A second shortcode on the same page shows nothing.
